name: b6406-dhikr
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, 7th-century Arabia, a bright clean room with whitewashed mud-brick walls and soft even daylight. Close shot of one anonymous RIGHT hand resting on the knee of a man seated cross-legged on a woven palm-fibre mat, counting dhikr on its fingers: the thumb tip touching the middle joint of the index finger, the other fingers relaxed. Exactly five fingers, natural proportions. Only the right hand, forearm and the knee in a plain white cotton garment are visible - no face, no head, no left hand. The camera looks across the hand toward a plain wall; no window, no door and no sun in frame. Warm, calm, vibrant colours, no modern objects, no prayer beads.
